subject: Clarifying PO requirements for Innovatix pilot — staged exception proposal
messages:
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@innovatix.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Blake <t.blake@innovatix.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Innovatix is excited to run the 6-week pilot with Redwood — the feature fit looks promising. A quick procurement question before we start: our AP team mandates a Purchase Order on vendor invoices for vendor spend above $5k/month. The pilot is estimated at ~$3.2k/month but may spike during evaluation.

Is there an established short-term "invoice-only" or "trial" path at Redwood that avoids issuing a PO? If not, what exception evidence do you need so our finance team can approve a temporary no-PO route?

I can share Innovatix's vendor intake form and PO policy if that helps.

Best,
Elena Varga
Head of Procurement | Innovatix Inc.
E: elena.varga@innovatix.com
T: +1-617-555-0213

--
Attachment: Innovatix_vendor_intake.pdf (stub)

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@innovatix.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Elena —

Appreciate the note and the vendor intake PDF — helpful context. Short answer: yes, we can support a limited invoice-only pilot for Innovatix, but it needs a short approval route and a few guardrails from both sides.

What we typically require for a temporary no-PO pilot (summary):
- Signed onboarding form (attached) and PO policy acknowledgement.
- Maximum spend cap for the pilot period (you propose; we can enforce throttles).
- Fixed pilot window (we recommend 6–8 weeks).
- Invoices submitted monthly with acceptance criteria tied to the SOW so finance can reconcile spend to deliverables.
- A named approver from your Finance/Procurement who signs the exception.

I've attached our Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf and a short Exceptions_Criteria.xlsx that lists the evidence we track for approvals. Laura (finance) is cc'd and can confirm the internal approval steps on our side.

If Innovatix can sign the onboarding form and confirm a $6k total cap for the pilot, I can route a one-time exception to our billing governance for approval.

Next steps: Elena, can you confirm the approver name and whether Innovatix is comfortable with a $6k total cap? Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Phone: +1-415-555-0124

Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf (stub)

From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@innovatix.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Blake <t.blake@innovatix.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Sergio,

Thanks — that list is clear and reasonable. We can do the onboarding form (I'll get it back by EOD tomorrow). Our Finance approver will be Tom Blake (Director, Finance Ops) — he's cc'd. On the cap: Innovatix is comfortable with a $6k total cap for the 6-week pilot.

A couple of clarifications from Tom: 1) will Redwood accept invoices that reference a HubSpot deal ID and the signed onboarding form as acceptable evidence in lieu of a PO during the pilot? 2) what payment terms would apply for the pilot invoice(s) — Net 30?

I attached our intake form in case you want to pre-populate any fields.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: Innovatix_vendor_intake_filled_stub.pdf (stub)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Varga <elena.varga@innovatix.com>, Tom Blake <t.blake@innovatix.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Thanks for looping me in. Quick confirmation from finance: we can approve a temporary invoice-only pathway for Innovatix under these conditions:

- Signed onboarding form + Innovatix vendor intake on file.
- Single exception approval (Finance Director sign-off) documented in our system.
- Maximum pilot cap enforced ($6k total).
- Invoices must include: HubSpot deal ID (INN-98765), reference to the signed onboarding form, and the billed period.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt. If Innovatix requires an earlier term, we can discuss, but Net 30 is standard.

Marissa / Sergio: I'll need the completed onboarding form and a short cover email from Tom approving the exception. Once I receive that, I'll create the exception entry and notify billing to accept invoice-only routing for the pilot.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: Exceptions_Criteria.xlsx (for reference)

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@innovatix.com>, Tom Blake <t.blake@innovatix.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO requirement question

Elena / Tom — great, all set. Thank you for the quick turnaround, Tom, for confirming approval below. To make this formal:

- Innovatix will sign the attached Redwood_Onboarding_Form and return it by EOD Monday (we have your filled intake).
- Tom provided written approval for a one-time invoice-only exception for the 6-week pilot (cap $6k).
- Redwood will accept invoices that include HubSpot deal ID INN-98765 and reference the signed onboarding form; billing will process on Net 30.
- We'll attach the Draft_SOW-Innovatix.pdf to the onboarding packet so both teams have acceptance criteria for month-end reconciliation.

I'll open the exception request in our billing system and follow up with a confirmation email once the exception ID is created (CC: Laura). If anything changes on Innovatix's side, please flag immediately so we don't miss the billing window.

Sergio Alvarez
